guesses.decision: Wrapped the whole stall-memory step in `IF progress_period > 0`, so a tuned value of 0 skips Step 1 instead of dividing by zero.
guesses.why: AGENTS.md rule 5 requires guarding every MOD; progress_period is a tunable param, not a literal.

guesses.decision: Read controlX/controlY(objective) without checking objective >= 0. If the activation runs with objective = -1, the host returns -1 (invalid index), so there is no runtime error. The goal is then (-1, -1), which the engine clamps.
guesses.why: The spec has no objective >= 0 guard here, unlike the default_goal/resupply/fall_back steps. The selector presumably runs this only when S.has_target_heart is on, and controlX(-1) is safe.

guesses.decision: Same as C.take_heart: no objective >= 0 guard, relying on controlX(-1) = -1 being safe.
guesses.why: Literal reading of the spec. The host returns -1 for invalid indices instead of raising an error.

guesses.decision: Used the legacy host fields carrying, ownHeartStolen, heartX and heartY exactly as written. Under rules 47 carrying and ownHeartStolen are always 0 and heartX/heartY read the enemy home, so in practice the goal is the thief (never set, see gaps) or the enemy home.
guesses.why: The spec names these fields explicitly and matches base.bas; I did not substitute control* fields.

guesses.decision: Read sk_motor__threw as left by the most recent SK.motor run before __send. If send runs before motor on a tick, the callout comes one tick late.
guesses.why: Call order is generated and not visible to the unit.

gaps.need: playerCarrying(i) to find a visible enemy heart carrier (thief)
gaps.substitute: Called playerCarrying as specified. Under rules 47 it always returns 0, so thief stays -1 and carrier_bonus never applies.

gaps.need: carrying and playerCarrying to block supply detours while a heart is carried
gaps.substitute: Used the legacy fields as specified. Both are always 0 under rules 47, so the block never triggers.
Used the legacy host field as specified. It is always 0 under rules 47, so NOT carrying is always true.
Used the legacy fields as specified. Under rules 47 they read 0, 0 and the enemy home.

lessons: Legacy capture-the-flag fields (carrying, playerCarrying, ownHeartStolen, heartX/heartY) are constant under rules 47; specs that branch on them compile but those branches are dead.
